query:

Options:
A. Marcus
B. Callum
C. Omar
D. Dev

query:
One member first observed aloud that Callum was carrying more stress than usual and that his work had been difficult — framing it as something they had noticed but that Callum himself would not say in the chat. A different member in the same session agreed with this reading. Which member made the original observation about Callum's stress?

Options:
A. Omar
B. Jade
C. Temi
D. Lena
context:
[1] (about=Temi, episodic, t12 @2026-04-14T19:56:00) for what it's worth Callum's been carrying more than usual lately. work's been tough on him. I don't think he'd say that here but it was obvious at the reunion dinner when he relaxed around nine and actually seemed to enjoy it. he needed that evening.
[2] (about=Callum, episodic, t14 @2026-09-14T20:40:00) right, moving on before this becomes a therapy session. Omar, what's the tournament format
[3] (about=Callum, episodic, t18 @2026-12-07T20:54:00) not touching that one. but yes. Noted.
[4] (about=Callum, episodic, t4 @2026-01-19T20:23:00) double-header runs long. documentary then dinner means nobody's done by nine. but that's just me
[5] (about=Callum, episodic, t10 @2026-03-23T20:23:00) was a good night. had to leave at nine but the first part was the best part anyway, if I'm honest
[6] (about=Callum, said_by=Temi, profile, t12 @2026-04-14T19:45:00) Temi notes Callum has been carrying more than usual lately, work's been tough on him, and he needed the reunion dinner evening
[7] (about=Callum, core, t4 @2026-01-19T20:13:00) Callum cites having kids as an excuse for leaving early, but frames it as just his way.
[8] (about=Callum, said_by=Omar, profile, t4 @2026-01-19T20:13:00) Omar notes Callum left the pub night at around 9:30 as usual, implying a recurring early departure pattern.
[9] (about=Callum, core, t10 @2026-03-23T20:11:00) Callum had to leave at nine but thought the first part was the best part.
[10] (about=Dev, episodic, t12 @2026-04-14T19:53:00) callum just voluntarily considered something new. checks notes, this is growth
[11] (about=Jade, core, t4 @2026-01-19T20:13:00) Jade says nobody is worried about the nine o'clock cutoff except Callum, and thinks the documentary idea is good.
[12] (about=Omar, episodic, t18 @2026-12-07T21:04:00) callum staying past 9 is officially the comeback story of 2026 😂😂
agent_answer:
**C. Temi**

The original observation — that Callum had "been carrying more than usual lately," that "work's been tough on him," and that he wouldn't say so himself, though it was obvious at the reunion dinner — is attributed to **Temi** (raw excerpt [1] and Temi's cell in the memory slice).
